svg.text: C Hoses: a cast gooseneck rises from the plate's edge over each fitting (plate iron) and a ribbed hose sweeps from it in one curve, lifting over the bays' corners where it must, down onto a cast nozzle on
the shoulder's rim (press iron), clamped at both ends; no straights and no elbows (the cryogenic plant's hoses from cast corner boxes).

Runs (plan; N/S keyed by the fitting's side of x, E/W by north/south of centre): E+: 1.01 long, turns 4 deg, over bay 0.31 for 0.66; E-: 1.14 long, turns 27 deg; N+: 0.95 long, turns 23 deg, over bay 0.14 for 0.48; N-: 0.95 long, turns 23 deg, over bay 0.14 for 0.48;
S+: 0.95 long, turns 23 deg, over bay 0.14 for 0.48; S-: 0.95 long, turns 23 deg, over bay 0.14 for 0.48; W+: 1.01 long, turns 4 deg, over bay 0.31 for 0.66; W-: 1.14 long, turns 27 deg.

Clearance, bore edge in plan, worst over all 8 fittings: bastions 0.01, guide feet 0.23, shoulder before the socket 0.17; off the plate 0; never turns back (the distance still to go falls all the way, every run).
